'''''Crystal and Edge: Lightsaber Construction and Philosophy''''' was a text written by members of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] on the construction of [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]] and the weapon's relation to [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] philosophy. It was included in a list of suggested texts for [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]] to peruse during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].<ref name="Encyclopedia" />

==Behind the scenes==
''Crystal and Edge:'' was mentioned in the [[2012]] reference guide ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />
